title: Elizondo worked with Grusch in a SCIF
summary: Lou Elizondo tells of Elizondo worked with Grusch in a SCIF, about an unknown time at undisclosed SCIF, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I I worked with the guy I can't say where I've been asked not to say where we both worked in a skift together he had every access that you needed to have and he saw the same information I did

plain: Lou Elizondo, a former defense intelligence official, says he worked alongside David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who became a whistleblower on government UFO secrets, in a SCIF, a sealed room for handling classified material. Elizondo says he has been asked not to say where it was. He says Grusch had all the access he needed and saw the same information Elizondo did, which he offers as backing for Grusch's claims.
